Wild season ends in 4-3 overtime loss to Avalanche in NHL Playoffs
Minnesota Wild coach John Hynes spoke to reporters after Wednesday night's 4-3 overtime loss to the Colorado Avalanche in Game 5 of the Western Conference Semifinals. The Wild's season is over after losing the series 4-1.
